HKStatisticsQuery *discreteQuery = [[HKStatisticsQuery alloc] initWithQuantityType:discreteHeartRate quantitySamplePredicate:nil options:HKStatisticsOptionDiscreteAverage | HKStatisticsOptionDiscreteMin | HKStatisticsOptionDiscreteMax | HKStatisticsOptionSeparateBySource completionHandler:^(HKStatisticsQuery *query, HKStatistics *result, NSError *error) { // ... process the results here }]; ```
